messages.text:
The first validation found the actual integration issue: the installed TanStack Start entrypoint expects `getRouter`, while my router file exported only `createRouter`.

I’m correcting that Start boundary and rerunning the failed build/browser checks plus the already-passing backend tests if the build gets past this point.
